verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a national IP office's online filing service can publish the account, authentication and identity-verification steps up front. But no evidence item describes any login, credential (e.g. citizen card or digital key) or identity-proofing requirement. The 'Guia de pedido online de marcas e logótipos' is only a title, with no content showing it discloses these steps before filing, and the other items cover substantive IP procedures.
